G19.root_cause_detail: main.combat_enemy_common ($ActorRoot/EnemyB03) carries a static @export var target_ref baked into Main.tscn (interaction_target.gd:12), fixed to NPC-01-01-01-009 since long before this round. The backend's own dev-bootstrap self-heal logic (andromeda_authority_adapter.py ~line 1090-1140) correctly detects a defeated/non-pristine stored target and rotates to a fresh, alive, full-health candidate (confirmed live: rotated 009->012 in s16b_bootstrap after the Combat gate defeated 009 earlier in this same persistent world) — but the Godot scene's static export never re-reads that rotation. G19's combat step therefore keeps attacking the old, already-DEFEATED npc. Confirmed by direct read-only SQLite inspection of arpg_enemy_combat_state both before and after: NPC-01-01-01-009 life_state=DEFEATED health=0.0 throughout; NPC-01-01-01-012 (the backend's new live COMMON candidate) was ALIVE at full health 95.0/95.0 and never targeted by the Godot client.
